resources.title: Emergency Contacts & Guide
resources.subtitle: If you are in immediate danger, please contact the emergency services below. Do not hesitate to ask for help.
resources.polri_desc: For emergencies that directly threaten life or physical safety.
resources.sapa_desc: Special services for handling cases of violence against women and children.
resources.wa_sapa_desc: Alternative if calling is not possible (text chat only).
resources.wa_humas_desc: Public complaint service for criminal acts, including sexual violence.
resources.spkt_desc: Integrated Police Service Center. Visit directly to make an official police report.
resources.guide_1: Make sure you are in a safe place before calling.
resources.guide_2: State the exact location of the incident or where you are.
resources.guide_4: If you cannot speak, use WhatsApp and inform them you cannot make a call.
